title: Compound Interest Calculator
description:
```
Principal: 1000
Annual rate (%): 5
Years: 10
Compounded monthly.
Final amount: $1647.01
Interest earned: $647.01
Doubles in about 14.4 years (rule of 72)
```
hints: `const double r{ ratePercent / 100.0 };` then `std::pow(1.0 + r / monthsPerYear, monthsPerYear * years)`.
The rule of 72: an amount roughly doubles in `72 / ratePercent` years. Interest earned is the final amount minus the principal.
stretch: also show yearly and daily compounding side by side.
